deployments_detail.use: "aiSure" product insuring performance risk of AI models; 100+ AI experts; AI a central lever of "Ambition 2030" strategy across value chain

GenAI Co-Pilot on the REALYTIX ZERO cloud underwriting platform: underwriters/insurers enter natural-language prompts and the generative-AI assistant turns them into detailed insurance product proposals that can be launched via the online product studio within hours. Munich Re describes it as its first deployment of generative AI in an operational setting. [Munich Re REALYTIX ZERO (generative AI)]

aiSure / Insure AI: parametric insurance product that assumes the performance risk of third-party AI models (e.g. fraud detection, asset valuation, automated claims). Munich Re wrote the first insurance policy for an AI model's performance in 2018 and continues to underwrite AI-performance guarantees backed by its reinsurance capacity. [Munich Re (aiSure)]

Predictor AI-augmented underwriting platform (Automation Solutions): combines rules-based analysis, third-party data and machine learning to score risk and automate life & health underwriting decisions. Munich Re runs the end-to-end AI model development, deployment, monitoring and maintenance and offers reinsurance on AI-underwritten policies. Available to L&H insurers in APAC/MEA. [Munich Re Automation Solutions (Predictor, integrates ALLFINANZ/SPARK/NOVA)]

CatAI program: computer-vision models analyze post-disaster aerial imagery to identify the most damaged areas, prioritize claims-adjuster response and speed reimbursement after natural catastrophes. Built with Google Cloud using Visual Inspection AI, semi-supervised segmentation and TPUs. [Google Cloud (Visual Inspection AI, TPUs); Google Research]
deployments_detail.value: 92% faster model training; ~90% less labeled data; deployment in ~1/3 the time and ~1/3 the cost vs traditional methods

deployments_detail.use: Sixfold AI integration into REALYTIX ZERO: embeds Sixfold's generative-AI risk analysis directly into the underwriting workflow, auto-reviewing and enriching submissions with external data, generating an 'appetite fit' score to prioritize submissions and assisting underwriters with referral and rating decisions plus downstream quoting/binding. [Sixfold (AI underwriting) on Munich Re REALYTIX ZERO]

Location Risk Intelligence platform (Risk Management Partners): analytics platform that scores climate and natural-hazard physical risk for any location or asset portfolio worldwide, including a Climate Change Edition with IPCC-compliant forward-looking scenarios, used to improve portfolio and claims management. Distributed as SaaS via Microsoft marketplace and Nasdaq Data Link. [Munich Re on Microsoft Azure; distributed via Nasdaq Data Link]

alitheia automated life & disability underwriting platform (Munich Re US Life): uses patented AI and natural-language processing plus configurable rules and real-time data to automate rapid risk assessment and instant underwriting decisions for term-life products sold online. Deployed by carriers including John Hancock. [Munich Re (alitheia, patented AI/NLP)]
deployments_detail.value: processes ~75% of cases in less than 48 hours

deployments_detail.use: SMAART analytics platform AI chatbot (Munich Re HealthTech): a natural-language, AI-powered chatbot that lets users query the SMAART health-insurance analytics platform and get instant answers across multiple languages. [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI services]
